subject: Post-call alignment: decision lane & timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@avatech.com>, Jason Lee <jason@avatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call alignment: decision lane & timeline

Hi Sara / Jason —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we have a shared decision lane to move from discovery -> pilot -> purchase:  

Key pains you confirmed:
- Latency and cost spikes on burst customer traffic for the NLU pipeline (esp. peak shopping hours).
- Lack of prefix/KV caching leading to repeated token cost on similar user queries.
- Need predictable inference SLA and audit logs for merchant disputes.

Top goals you called out:
1) Reduce 95th-percentile latency by ~30% for the conversational agents in checkout.
2) Cut per-call token cost by ~20% on high-frequency intent paths.
3) Pilot within a non-prod AWS VPC and validate audit logs / retention.

Proposed mutual action plan (MPA) — milestones, owners, target dates:
- Discovery follow-up (Redwood demo + perf baseline): target Oct 20 — Owner: Irene Choi (Redwood) / Sara Nguyen (Ava)
- Pilot readiness (VPC access + sample workload): target Nov 3 — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood infra) / Jason Lee (Ava eng)
- Pilot run (2-week production-like traffic window): target Nov 10-24 — Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood CS) / Jason Lee (Ava eng)
- Evaluation & decision (cost/latency QA + procurement): target Dec 1 — Owner: Sara Nguyen (Ava) / Irene Choi (Redwood)

Open items we promised to surface:
- SOC 2 / security docs (I attached the summary and drive link).
- Pricing band for a pilot of dedicated capacity vs hosted API (I included a short estimate in the attached MPA).
- Network/VPC checklist and needed firewall rules.

Next steps — please confirm by EOD Tue: 1) stakeholders above are correct and 2) the dates are feasible for your procurement cadence. If agreed, I’ll schedule the perf-baseline demo and loop in infra to start VPC prep.

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA with milestones + ownership + tentative pricing)

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0133
irene_choi@redwood.com

--

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call alignment: decision lane & timeline

Thanks, Irene — nice summary. A few quick confirmations and questions:  

Confirmations:
- Stakeholders: Sara (buyer/ops), Jason (eng lead) — correct. Also adding our Security lead, Priya Rao, to the loop for the SOC2/retention questions (she’s on copy on later threads).
- Goals: agree with the latency & cost targets. The 30% latency reduction is aspirational but reasonable to aim for in the pilot.

Questions / small adjustments:
- Can we shift the pilot run window two weeks later? Nov 24–Dec 8 would work better for our QA calendar.
- For the SOC 2 docs — we’ll need the full report or will the summary + SOC contact suffice for our procurement?
- Pricing: can you send the two quick options (hosted API credit-based pilot vs one-month dedicated capacity estimate) as a one-page comparison? That’ll speed legal/procurement.

I reviewed the MPA attachment quickly — looks good. If you can move the pilot start to Nov 24, we can aim for a procurement decision by Dec 15 instead of Dec 1.

On Tue I’ll confirm Priya’s calendar for a quick 30-min security call.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Director, Platform Operations | Ava Technologies
+sara@avatech.com

Next: I’ll schedule a 30-min security sync for later this week (Monica to propose times). Once Priya confirms availability, we’ll lock the pilot start and I’ll share the onboarding checklist for your infra team.
